run_retriever_training: run the retriever model training loop with distributed training and gradient accumulation
evaluate_retriever_model: evaluate the retriever model on a dataset and compute inversions and top-k metrics
create_retriever_config: create a RetrieverConfig with indexing dimension, question mask, passage mask, and projection settings
load_retriever_checkpoint: load a retriever model checkpoint with optimizer and scheduler state from disk
setup_retriever_collator: setup a RetrieverCollator with a BERT tokenizer for question and passage tokenization
